views.name: v_client_district
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database financial (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View ket hop khach hang va thong tin quan/huyen (district) */ CREATE VIEW v_client_district AS SELECT client.client_id, client.gender, client.birth_date, district.district_id, district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS region, district.A4 AS no_of_inhabitants, district.A11 AS avg_salary FROM client LEFT JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

views.name: v_account_district
views.create_sql: /* 2. View ket hop tai khoan va thong tin quan/huyen */ CREATE VIEW v_account_district AS SELECT account.account_id, account.frequency, account.date AS account_created_date, district.district_id, district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS region, district.A11 AS avg_salary FROM account LEFT JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

views.name: v_account_loan
views.create_sql: /* 3. View ket hop tai khoan va khoan vay (loan) */ CREATE VIEW v_account_loan AS SELECT account.account_id, account.frequency, account.date AS account_date, loan.loan_id, loan.date AS loan_date, loan.amount AS loan_amount, loan.duration AS loan_duration, loan.payments AS loan_payments, loan.status AS loan_status FROM account LEFT JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
